Loading arrows for a biplot

Source: R/pcatools_helpers.R
INTERNAL_pca_loading_arrows.Rd

Picks the n variables with the largest absolute loading on each of the two components (as PCAtools::biplot() does with ntopLoadings) and scales their loadings into score space. The scale is the smaller of the two axes' ratio of score range to loading range, times length.factor, so the longest arrows span a comparable distance to the samples. (PCAtools computes max(scores) - min(scores) / range(loadings) there, an operator-precedence slip; this uses the ratio of ranges it intends.)

Usage

.pca_loading_arrows(p, x, y, n = 5, length.factor = 1.5)

Arguments

p

A pca object.

x, y

Component names on the two axes.

n

Number of top variables per component.

length.factor

Arrow length multiplier.

Value

A data frame with variable, xend, yend.
